Problem401.description: Authentication is missing, expired, revoked, or has the wrong audience.

Problem403.description: The authenticated subject lacks the required permission or data scope.

Problem404.description: The resource does not exist or is deliberately hidden by ownership rules.

Problem409.description: The command conflicts with current state, replay scope, or a concurrent command.

Problem412.description: The supplied entity version is stale.

Problem428.description: A required precondition such as If-Match is missing.

Problem429.description: The caller exceeded an API or Agent rate limit.

Problem500.description: The service failed without exposing internal details.

Problem503.description: A required dependency is unavailable or the write outcome is unknown.
